sloka: नैव साम्ना न दानेन न भेदेन कुतो युधा।सा द्रुष्टुमपि शक्येत नैव चान्येन केनचित् ।। ६.८४.१२ ।।
transliteration: naiva sāmnā na dānena na bhedena kuto yudhā।sā druṣṭumapi śakyeta naiva cānyena kenacit ।। 6.84.12 ।।

translations.english: 'Not by conciliation, nor by sowing dissension, nor by gifts — how then by war? She cannot even be seen by any means whatsoever.'
